meta.description: Official Anthropic SDK patterns for TypeScript/Node.js — client setup, Messages API, streaming, tool use, vision, extended thinking, structured outputs, prompt caching, batch API, and production best practices

copy.tagline: 用 Anthropic SDK 构建 AI 功能
copy.tagline_en: Build AI features with Anthropic SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call Claude's Messages API and tool use with TypeScript.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过官方 SDK 直接调用 Messages API、流式响应、工具调用、视觉识别、扩展思考、结构化输出、提示缓存和批量处理。
howto.when: 当你在 TypeScript/Node.js 项目中需要直接调用 Claude 模型（Opus、Sonnet、Haiku）时触发。

say.text: 用 Messages API 写一个多轮对话。
say.note: Claude 会生成带 max_tokens 的请求代码。

say.text: 帮我实现一个工具调用循环，获取天气。
用 Zod 定义结构化输出并解析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can directly use the official SDK to call Messages API, streaming, tool use, vision, extended thinking, structured outputs, prompt caching, and batch processing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to call Claude models (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) directly in a TypeScript/Node.js project.

say_en.text: Write a multi-turn conversation using Messages API.
say_en.note: Claude will generate request code with max_tokens.

say_en.text: Implement a tool use loop to get weather.
say_en.note: Claude will show tool_use and tool_result interaction.

say_en.text: Define structured output with Zod and parse it.
say_en.note: Claude will use zodOutputFormat and messages.parse.
